title: Broker-carrier dual authority: questions before expanding
seoTitle: Broker-carrier dual authority: questions before expanding
searchIntent: What does broker-carrier dual authority mean?
excerpt: Consider the operating workload, role clarity and professional review needed before combining carrier and brokerage activities.
takeaway: Dual authority brings carrier and brokerage responsibilities into the business. Decide whether you can manage both, clearly identify your role on each shipment and verify the proposed structure with qualified advisers.

sections.title: What does broker-carrier dual authority mean?
paragraphs: In this lesson, Luis discusses businesses that operate as carriers and also arrange transportation as brokers. His main concern is operational: adding a second activity creates another set of responsibilities. It does not simply give a salesperson a new answer to “Are you asset based?”

A fleet needs attention to drivers, equipment and maintenance. A brokerage needs dependable carrier selection, customer development and shipment coordination. An owner considering both needs a credible plan for who manages each function.

sections.title: Be clear about the role on each shipment
paragraphs: The customer should understand which business is accepting the work and in what capacity. The contracts, instructions and actual transportation arrangement need to match. Do not assume a carrier commitment can be changed into a brokerage arrangement without checking the relevant permissions and obligations.

FMCSA guidance focuses on the activities performed when distinguishing brokerage and agency roles. A company label or the fact that two businesses share ownership does not answer every question about a specific shipment.

sections.title: Budget the management time as well as the money
paragraphs: Luis’s advice is to avoid expanding merely because a prospect asked whether you own trucks. Consider how a breakdown, driver issue or urgent service problem would compete with the attention your existing brokerage requires.
Write down the people, systems and escalation process for both sides. If the same person must handle every exception, test whether the operating plan is realistic before taking on more commitments.

sections.title: Verify the structure before committing
paragraphs: Review the proposed authority, contracts and insurance with transportation counsel and insurance professionals familiar with the actual activities. Coverage and obligations depend on the arrangement; blanket statements that every structure is prohibited or every claim is excluded are not a reliable plan.

Luis prefers the brokerage model for his own business. You can take the useful question from that preference without treating it as a universal rule: does this expansion solve a real customer need that your team is equipped to serve?
